The '''Rooshan''' were a small clan of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] that controlled the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lohema]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the clan was led by [[Pon Rooshan]] and was rivals with the [[Ku'rys]] clan of [[Joreikna]].<ref name="GatORW" />
